description: Test suite for the voice wake configuration module, testing loading, sanitizing, and persistence of voice trigger configurations.

methods.name: loadVoiceWakeConfig
methods.description: Loads the voice wake configuration from the specified directory, applying defaults if necessary.

methods.name: setVoiceWakeTriggers
methods.description: Sanitizes and persists an array of voice trigger strings to the configuration directory.

methods.name: defaultVoiceWakeTriggers
methods.description: Returns the default set of voice wake triggers.

ctags.name: saved
ctags.pattern: /^      const saved = await setVoiceWakeTriggers(["  hi  ", "", "  there "], baseDir);$/
